newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT surges, helped by dollar.
newsitem.headline: PT surges, helped by dollar.

text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom SA rose 3.5 percent amid strong demand, encouraged by a stronger dollar and reports about the entry of a strategic partner in the next stage of privatisation, dealers said.
"Demand for PT is buoyant. I think the reasons are the dollar and news about partners and strategic alliances," said one operator.

The privatisation of 26 percent of the capital of PT, expected in September, could include a stake destined for strategic alliances or partners, deputy Finance Minister Fernando Teixeira dos Santos told Reuters in an interview.
PT shares hit a high of 6,140 escudos before easing back to 6,101 escudos, up 171, in volume of 428,534 at 1618 GMT.
